text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, the property appears to be legally compliant regarding forests. No forest cover was detected as of 2020 (the baseline date), according to the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset. While some tree-cover loss events were observed before the baseline (2008, 2015, 2017, and 2020), these occurred prior to the compliance checkpoint. Since 2020, only small, non-event patches of loss (<0.5 ha) were detected in 2021, which do not affect compliance. Thus, the property meets the criteria for legal compliance regarding forests as of the baseline date.
